newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DHL says first A300B4-F delivery in mid-Sep.
newsitem.headline: DHL says first A300B4-F delivery in mid-Sep.

text.p: European Air Transport (EAT), the air transport arm of DHL International, said it had set provisional delivery dates for an order of three Airbus 300B4-200 converted freighter aircraft.
The aircraft are being taken on long-term lease from U.S.-based Pinnacle Aircraft Leasing.
"The first of the aircraft should arrive by mid to end-September and the second a month later," Brussels- based EAT managing director, Gordon Olafson, told Reuters.

The two aircraft had been earmarked for operation on DHL's high-growth routes between Brussels and Scandinavia (Stockholm, Oslo and Copenhagen) which also serve East Midlands airport in the UK, Olafson said.

"The Airbus 300s will replace a Douglas DC8 and two Boeing 727-100s currently on these routes which will deployed elsewhere on our intra-European network. In tonnage terms, the change of aircraft will not be too significant," he said.
"However, the A300s are superior in their ability to handle high-cube shipments and also offer greater flexibillity in spliting shipments."
EAT expected the third Airbus 300 to be in service by March 1998 but it was too early to say on which routes it would operate on, Olafson added.
EAT is also to take delivery of a further two Boeing 727Fs by end-August taking its fleet of this aircraft to 28.

Included in this overall figure is a recently delivered 727-200 - which replaces a 727-100 released for by DHL International in Guatemala as well as a second 727-200 replacing a 727-100 which will be used in Venezuela.
" The 727-200 offers an extra three pallet positions to the 100s so there is a useful capacity gain." - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
